alt.en: A printed page headed The Faithful Witness: lines of words, each above a row of small letters (c, d, e, g) set between bar lines, standing for the notes.
alt.es: Una página impresa titulada The Faithful Witness: renglones de texto, cada uno sobre una fila de letras pequeñas (c, d, e, g) entre barras de compás, que representan las notas.

caption.en: Shaker tunes written with letters instead of note heads, in A Sacred Repository of Anthems and Hymns (Canterbury, New Hampshire, 1852), the first Shaker book of printed tunes by its own preface; Mary Hazzard's handwritten Simple Gifts also uses letters for notes.
caption.es: Melodías shakers escritas con letras en lugar de cabezas de nota, en A Sacred Repository of Anthems and Hymns (Canterbury, Nuevo Hampshire, 1852), el primer libro shaker de melodías impresas según su propio prólogo; el Simple Gifts manuscrito de Mary Hazzard también escribe las notas con letras.

source: A Sacred Repository of Anthems and Hymns, for Devotional Worship and Praise (Canterbury, N.H., 1852), p. 1, "The Faithful Witness"
library: Princeton Theological Seminary Library (scan on the Internet Archive)
licenceEvidence: Printed at Canterbury, N.H., 1852; the preface is signed "H. C. B." (Henry Clay Blinn, 1824-1905, per Hymnary.org and IMSLP). US: published before 1931. EU and Israel: life plus 70 ended 1975. Faithful scan of a flat page.
credit: Princeton Theological Seminary Library, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A black and white photograph of a long white clapboard building with a gambrel roof, three dormer windows, two front doors and shuttered windows, behind a picket fence with steps up a grassy bank.
alt.es: Fotografía en blanco y negro de un edificio largo de tablas blancas con tejado abuhardillado, tres buhardillas, dos puertas delanteras y ventanas con contraventanas, tras una valla de estacas con escalones que suben por un talud de hierba.

caption.en: The Shakers' meetinghouse of 1794 at Sabbathday Lake in New Gloucester, Maine, photographed for the Historic American Buildings Survey in 1962.
caption.es: La casa de reunión de los shakers en Sabbathday Lake, en New Gloucester (Maine), construida en 1794 y fotografiada en 1962 para el Historic American Buildings Survey.

source: Historic American Buildings Survey, Gerda Peterich, photographer, June 1962, EAST ELEVATION - Sabbathday Lake Shaker Community Meetinghouse, Sabbathday Lake Village, Cumberland County, ME (HABS ME-107)

alt.en: A black and white photograph of a wide, bright room with exposed ceiling beams, tall windows, an iron stove on the left and rows of wooden benches on a plank floor.
alt.es: Fotografía en blanco y negro de una sala amplia y luminosa con vigas a la vista, ventanas altas, una estufa de hierro a la izquierda y filas de bancos de madera sobre un suelo de tablones.

caption.en: The meeting room inside, in 1962, with movable benches on an open plank floor: here the community met for worship, where songs held "a prominent place", as an 1852 Shaker tunebook puts it.
caption.es: La sala de reunión por dentro, en 1962, con bancos móviles sobre un suelo despejado de tablones: aquí se reunía la comunidad para el culto, en el que los cantos ocupaban "un lugar destacado", como dice un libro shaker de melodías de 1852.

source: Historic American Buildings Survey, Gerda Peterich, photographer, June 1962, MEETING ROOM, LEFT - Sabbathday Lake Shaker Community Meetinghouse, Sabbathday Lake Village, Cumberland County, ME (HABS ME-107)

alt.en: A plain wooden side chair with a curved back rail, four turned legs joined by rungs, and a woven seat in two tones.
alt.es: Una silla de madera sencilla con un travesaño curvo en el respaldo, cuatro patas torneadas unidas por travesaños y un asiento tejido en dos tonos.

caption.en: A plain maple side chair made by the Shakers at New Lebanon, New York, between 1840 and 1860, the same years Mary Hazzard copied Simple Gifts into her songbook, begun in 1847.
caption.es: Una silla sencilla de arce hecha por los shakers en New Lebanon (Nueva York) entre 1840 y 1860, los mismos años en que Mary Hazzard copió Simple Gifts en su cancionero, empezado en 1847.

source: Side Chair, American, Shaker, United Society of Believers in Christ's Second Appearing, New Lebanon, New York, maple
